name: tiktok-video-remover
description: A Chrome extension that lists every post on your TikTok account in a docked side panel and bulk-deletes the ones you select, by calling TikTok Studio's own API rather than automating the page.

scripts.check: node --check src/lib.js && node --check src/api.js && node --check src/posts.js && node --check src/runner.js && node --check src/select.js && node --check src/engine.js && node --check src/panel.js && node --check src/popup.js
scripts.package: npm run clean && mkdir -p dist && zip -qr dist/tiktok-video-remover-$npm_package_version.zip manifest.json icons src -x '*.DS_Store' && echo "dist/tiktok-video-remover-$npm_package_version.zip"
